cases.lesson: Use the survival function directly in an upper tail; subtracting a rounded CDF can erase the probability.
cases.boundary: The visualizer does not widen the documented Student-t degree-of-freedom or 1e-14 quantile-tail envelope.

cases.lesson: A visually close in-sample line from three observations supplies very little evidence about predictive performance.
cases.boundary: The result reports in-sample OLS evidence, not cross-validation or a causal claim.

cases.lesson: The static view marks observations with final Huber weight below 0.8 and the animation replays retained IRLS line updates.
cases.boundary: Robust residual weighting does not guarantee protection from high-leverage predictor values.

cases.lesson: Zero sample variance makes the t statistic undefined, so the visualization describes the structured failure instead of drawing an infinite statistic.
cases.boundary: No validated statistical claim is made for an invalid problem.
